policy: Public givens and conversion/quotient/remainder/scaling/quantity calculations are learner-entered in symbolic frames. No numeric prefill or main-answer transfer.
result: The mixed-number completion composes the whole part, numerator and denominator from validated learner inputs. Added optional serialized whole-result frame while preserving existing fraction/radical guide fields.
input: Numerator-only slots with a printed denominator and whole-number quantity answers use their ordinary integer input, not the general fraction input. The two mixed-number answer slots remain separate. Explicit answer-format overrides are preserved.
checks: Independent visible-number parsing and exact conversion, quotient/remainder, equivalent-fraction cross products and quantity multiplication.
Blank and incorrect inputs rejected; original question identity and answers remain unchanged by attachment.
Answer/expression metadata mutation does not alter help; old drafts reset and current partial drafts restore.
Mixed-result serialization retains the new optional whole-frame field.
Existing Brazil fraction curriculum checks retain independent answers and match the new learner-entered givens before the quantity calculations.
KO/EN/PT titles and every instruction and symbolic frame.
scope: Current integer-part conversions, divisible requested denominators and whole quantities divisible by the fraction denominator. General nondivisible quantity fractions are outside this slice.
limitations: Other fraction/decimal concept helpers and the full global app remain incomplete.
Native UI, learner inputs, screenshots and APK artifacts remain private.
